set_aside.subject: add_captured_trial_case
set_aside.text: - add_captured_trial_case: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] Only after every check passed, each spooled file's bytes are read with read_value_bytes from its spool source and published with put_value_bytes; every input becomes a StoredValue with the stored schema of its contract input port (M21) and the class that port declares, values keeping their value_digest and files becoming file-carriage StoredValues for the copied digests; inputs MUST list the refs as add_trial_case does, in port name order by Unicode code point, a many file port's refs one per file consecutive in list order; the case has no expected outputs, origin captured and captured_from the given source.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: Must add_captured_trial_case reject or exclude FileFactsRef inputs, or must the requirements provide a way to obtain their bytes so every accepted PortRef input can become a StoredValue?
